summary: Preserve model optimization opt-ins and atomic distributed autotune caches
compatibility: Experimental MiMo router weighting, GEMV, L2 prefetch, vocabulary sampling, and uncapped prefill switches default to off; explicit environment values still win.
details: Rank-union FlashInfer cache loading treats malformed JSON as a collective miss and all writes publish complete serialized state atomically.
Sparse attention plans retain storage-keyed weight identity and existing singleton-stride normalization.
